title: Optimization of the total tumor population under Gompertz growth
summary: We study optimal control problems for a stationary reaction--diffusion model describing the spatial distribution of a tumor cell population with Gompertz growth. The control $m(x)$ represents a treatment term acting as a density-dependent removal rate and it is subject to $L^{1}-L^{\infty}$ constraints. When the intrinsic growth rate is constant, the uniform distribution of the treatment is shown to be the unique minimizer.
